business_problem: HERON Group, a leading energy group in Greece, faced operational challenges as its legacy customer relationship management (CRM) system couldn't support its growing customer base and complex multi-channel journeys.
solution_summary: HERON Group built its Microsoft solution to improve seller-productivity and pipeline workflows. HERON Group, a leading energy group in Greece, faced operational challenges as its legacy customer relationship management (CRM) system couldn't support its growing customer base and complex multi-channel journeys. Key components included Power BI delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Dynamics 365 Sales delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Sales, where Dynamics 365 Sales assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft.

solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, narrative summaries, and self-service analytics to decision makers.

solution_components.role: Gives sales teams a unified CRM system for pipeline management and seller productivity.
